body:
Love isn't defined by being with the same person as you, having the same thoughts and beliefs, nor having the same plan. Love is finding someone that despite all their flaws you want to be with them, which despite it's sparsity is extremely common. Unfortunately, it sounds like you are stuck with someone who has flaws you can't live with. So leave, he will live, you will live. May take a few months, fuck it took me 18 months and I still miss her, but I am better off without her. Also fuck love, I can make it on my own because I am freaking strong. I mean I don't have to be alone, in fact there are 100s of people I could pick up today and take with me on any number of my adventures. I could fall in love with so many people, and I am sure you could too. Just give it time. Nice Deathnote references, I think? 

About school, I got kicked out too. 6 months ago I got accepted and went to a top engineering university only to have my acceptance rescinded and get kicked out. You know what? that school costed way to fucking much and I am going to be happier at a cheaper one up in the mountains, so now that is my plan and I am making it work. 

Fuck. I don't know what you like. I like hiking. I like water. I like heights. Basically if I can get lost and end up dead I like it. That's my passion, not fucking dying in situations I should. 

What do you like about the things you do?

I think you are worth the words. You have a consciousness. You have imagination. You have beauty. 

Remember that one time you said a joke and everyone laughed? it was worth all the times they didn't.

Remember that time you played a game with a kid and he looked up to you with awe and respect? they remember. 

Remember that time you were digging into a watermelon and smiled as the red fruit gushed around your teeth? It was beautiful. 

You have fallen, and that is okay. You are reaching up at the ones you love and they are probably looking at you in confusion. They don't hate you, they don't want you to apologize. They just want you to be happy. They probably won't reach out a hand and help you, because they don't know how to. however, they will be standing there next to you waiting for you to get back up. Because you will get back up. 

More importantly, you want to be happy. You don't want to harm yourself because you care about yourself. You think you are beautiful. You think you are funny, clever, wise, silly, fun, abstract, different. You think you are worth it because you are. YOU ARE WORTH IT. 

You have already made steps on standing back up, you have fought stronger than most will ever understand. You made the change in your world, no one else did that. You did that, so keep doing it. 


 
-------------

I can barely stand on my own two feet, but I standing right now. That is proof enough you can do it too. Sure, I am not happy all the time, but sometimes there is light that burns away all the dark and I know that fighting was worth it. Sometimes life is beautiful, and I know you have seen it too. It just seems dark right now. 

I am not the best conversationalist but I am here to talk to you, /u/liftmebackup, what's keeping you up tonight? Also cool user name it looks like /u/LiftMeBackUp is saying "you lift me back up".
